Total net sales for the five-week fiscal month increased 2.2 percent to $110.8 million compared to net sales of $108.4 million in the prior year five-week fiscal month ended October 4, 2025. On the mens side of the business, total sales for the five-week fiscal period ended October 3, 2026 increased 2.0 percent in comparison to the prior year five-week period ended October 4, 2025. The mens business represented approximately 48.0 percent of total sales for the month, consistent with the same period in the prior year. articles.summary: The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced today that comparable store net sales, for stores open at least one year, for the 5-week period ended October 3, 2026 increased 0.5 percent from comparable store net sales for the 5-week period ended October 4, 2025. Net sales for the 5-week fiscal month ended October 3, 2026 increased 2.2 percent to $110.8 million from net sales of $108.4 million for the prior year 5-week fiscal month ended October 4, 2025. Comparable store net sales year-to-date for the 35-week period ended October 3, 2026 increased 2.8 percent from comparable store net sales for the 35-week period ended October 4, 2025. Net sales for the 35-week fiscal period ended October 3, 2026 increased 4.6 percent to $842.8 million compared to net sales of $805.5 million for the prior year 35-week fiscal period ended October 4, 2025.
